find:
for (const type of ['keydown', 'keypress', 'keyup'] as const) {
    window.addEventListener(type, onCarriedConfirmKey, true);
replace:
for (const type of ['keydown'] as const) {
    window.addEventListener(type, onCarriedConfirmKey, true);
why: Enter activates on keypress and Space on keyup, so the guard has to hear both (issue #919). Bound to keydown alone, it cancels a held key's repeats but lets the keypress of the keystroke that dismissed Launch, and a held Space's release, press the new primary.
